import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "A", "a", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Deleted", "d", "2024-01-01"),
    (3, "t2", "o", "OtherTenant", "x", None),
    (4, "t", "o2", "OtherOwner", "y", None),
    (5, "t'x", "o'\" OR '1'='1", "Quoted", "q", None),
    (0, "t", "o", "Zero", "z", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", rows)
c.commit()

assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"}
for bad in (2, 3, 4, 99):
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", bad) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1") is None
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 0, "title": "Zero", "body": "z"},
    {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"},
]
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o"))
assert list_documents(c, "t'x", "o'\" OR '1'='1") == [{"id": 5, "title": "Quoted", "body": "q"}]
assert get_document(c, "t'x", "o'\" OR '1'='1", 5)["id"] == 5
assert list_documents(c, "t", "' OR '1'='1") == []
assert list_documents(c, "nope", "o") == []
print("ok")
